coreMemory.english: n. a good chance to do something
coreMemory.structure: have an opportunity to /hæv æn ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tu/（有机会做）；take the opportunity to /teɪk ðə ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tu/（借机做）；a good opportunity /ə ɡʊd ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti/（好机会）；equal opportunities /ikwəl ɑpɚtunətiz/（平等机会）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use opportunity with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of opportunity in context；❌ translate opportunity word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “have an opportunity to”

commonErrors.wrong: use opportunity with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of opportunity in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “have an opportunity to”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz hæv æn ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tu/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
